summary.text: Jim Rosapepe is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 21 who has held the seat since January 2007 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a former member of the Maryland House of Delegates and served as U.S. Ambassador to Romania from 1998 to 2001.

paragraphs.text: Jim Rosapepe was born in Rome, Italy, on May 20, 1951, according to his legislative biography.
He is the co-author of the 2009 book Dracula Is Dead: How Romanians Survived Communism, Ended It, and Emerged since 1989 as the New Italy.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.
Rosapepe served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 1987 to 1997 and then as U.S. Ambassador to Romania from 1998 to 2001.
He assumed office in the Maryland State Senate on January 10, 2007, and his current term ends in January 2027.
Rosapepe is vice chair of the Budget and Taxation Committee and a member of the Executive Nominations Committee, according to the General Assembly website.
Ballotpedia lists him as the Senate chair of the Spending Affordability Committee for the 2025-2026 term.
